entities.name: Query flavohemoprotein
observations: 393 aa protein with N-terminal globin domain and C-terminal FAD/NAD(P)-binding reductase region, based on Pfam and strong full-length homology.
Best reviewed homolog Q9I0H4 from Pseudomonas aeruginosa shares 73.8% identity and 100% query coverage.
Predicted to bind one heme b and one FAD per subunit.
Functional assignment: nitric oxide dioxygenase involved in aerobic NO detoxification.

entities.name: NO dioxygenation to nitrate
observations: NADPH form: 2 nitric oxide + NADPH + 2 O2 = 2 nitrate + NADP(+) + H(+).
NADH form: 2 nitric oxide + NADH + 2 O2 = 2 nitrate + NAD(+) + H(+).

entities.name: Heme b
observations: Prosthetic group bound by flavohemoprotein homologs; supports oxygen/NO chemistry in the globin domain.

entities.name: FAD
observations: Prosthetic cofactor bound by the reductase domain and used for electron transfer from NAD(P)H.
